rows.en: So you've shown up again!! Alien Baltan!!
So you've shown up again!! Alien Baltan!!
So you've shown up again!! Alien Baltan!!
So you've shown up again!! Alien Baltan!!
Ultraman, we are not the same as before.
This time, we will destroy you all and conquer your base.
Come on, Alien Baltan! I'll take you on as many times as it takes!
Come on, Alien Baltan! I'll take you on as many times as it takes!
Come on, Alien Baltan! I'll take you on as many times as it takes!
Come on, Alien Baltan! I'll take you on as many times as it takes!
Come on, Alien Baltan! I'll take you on as many times as it takes!
Now learn the true extent of our power!
Curse you...!!
As long as our brethren remain... we will invade... again and again...!
Remember this!! Ultra Warriors!
...No matter how many times you appear, we Ultra Warriors will protect the peace.
...However many times you show up, we Ultra Warriors will protect the peace.
...However many times you show up, we Ultra Warriors will protect the peace.
...However many times you show up, we Ultra Warriors will protect the peace.
...However many times you show up, we Ultra Warriors will protect the peace.
Au-au-au!
YOU DID WELL TO DEFEAT ALIEN BALTAN.
We stopped it before it happened thanks to your information, Pigmon.
We stopped it before it happened thanks to your information, Pigmon.
We stopped it before it happened thanks to your information, Pigmon.
We stopped it before it happened thanks to the info you gave us, Pigmon.
We stopped it before it happened thanks to your information, Pigmon.
I AM GLAD I COULD BE OF USE ONCE AGAIN.
NOW, I WILL RETURN TO INVESTIGATING THE CUBES.
Pigmon went off somewhere.
Obtained "Pencil Bomb".
Completed the quest "Alien Baltan Strikes Back".
You can report quests in the Quest Room at the base.
Fo, fo, fo, fo, fo...
...!? So you've shown up, Alien Baltan!
Bring me Ultraman. I have no business with anyone else.
We've learned someone in Shocker Cube is searching for RX. Take RX and go investigate.
Black Sun, listen well.
Who's there!?
That voice... Shadow Moon!
You will face me, Black Sun.
Wait! Please, wait!
Are you really Shadow Moon!? You're alive!?
Come, Black Sun. Fight me, Black Sun.
Answer me, Shadow Moon! Shadow Moon!!
Hey, RX, who was that just now?
...His name is Shadow Moon.
And he's my best friend.
Your best friend!? Then isn't he on our side?
The Crisis Empire controlled him, and he and I became enemies.
And in the end, I fought him... and I defeated him.
But Shadow Moon is alive. I have to meet him and see for myself.
Why the hell should I have to tag along with you?
Please. I have to stop him.
...Tch! Fine, let's get this over with!
I'm here, Shadow Moon! Where are you!?
Shadow Moon... So you really are alive.
Whoa!
Shadow Moon! Are you set on fighting me no matter what!?
Would you bring that nightmare back to life all over again!? Shadow Moon!!
I...! I don't want to fight you!
I don't want to fight!
Kuah!
Answer me, Shadow Moon! Say something!
My name is Shadow Moon, Black Sun.
The messenger of death, risen from Hell to bury you.
Uwaah!
Stop it, Shadow Moon! Stop!
Shadow Moon, the Prince of Shadows, lost all memory of his days as Black RX's best friend.
That was the heavy price he paid to survive, and only barely at that.
And so he wandered, driven by the one thing he had left:
the instinct to defeat Kamen Rider Black RX...
And now, Black RX understood as well.
The Shadow Moon he once knew was dead.
What stood before him now was another mighty enemy, every bit the equal of Crisis.
Gwah!
Ngh! He's strong!
Ngh! He's strong!
Ngh! He's strong!

notes.note: Rows 26-29, 34-37, 45-48 and 51-55 are party-variant copies the script never plays (Quest016 is fixed to Ultraman, who uses rows 25/33/44). Identical Japanese kept identical; 45-48 use the rougher first-person-plural wording, so they differ slightly from Ultraman's polite row 44.

Speakers from Quest016.bla, mapping N+1 (row = TextIdOffset+n+1), calibrated on empty rows 31/39/43 and the OkWin rows 63-64: 30/32/38/40/41 Alien Baltan, 33/44 Ultraman. Row 42 is not called by the script; read as Alien Baltan's parting shot.

Rows 49-57 are unused by the script. Katakana-speech rows 50/56/57 read as Pigmon via the translator, rendered in caps without -pi like quest_010's katakana Pigmon lines; 51-55 are hero variants addressing Pigmon.
Item not found in the item tables; 'Pencil Bomb' is the Science Patrol weapon's established English name.
Speakers: 66/68 Alien Baltan, 67 Ankh (wrong-party branch). Laugh matches quest_011's comma version of the identical Japanese (quest_010 used 'Fofofofofo...').
Quest intro (3-line layout in Japanese) written as one line; matches QuestMess quest-017 wording.

Speakers from Quest017.bla, mapping N+1 (calibrated on empty rows 2/5/12/23-25 and OkWin rows 129/131). Row 3 is shown with a '???' name label; it is Shadow Moon. 'Black Sun' (Shadow Moon's name for RX) is not in the glossary.
Not called by the script (unused); speaker unknown, left neutral.
Ankh accompanies RX in this event (rows 13/16/20/22).
The source says the Crisis Empire manipulated Shadow Moon (in the TV series it was Gorgom); translated as written.
RX asking Ankh to come with him.
Not called by the script (unused); RX's voice.
Narration (no name label), in the style of the TV series narrator. Rows 45/46 are one sentence split across boxes; English restructured so each box stands alone while keeping the full meaning.
'Crisis' kept short for the Crisis Empire as in the source.
Rows 55-68 are party-leader variants not played in this event (RX alone speaks row 54); identical Japanese kept identical.

report: Speakers from Quest016/017.bla (both N+1). Unused party-variant rows translated by wording. 'Black Sun' and 'Pencil Bomb' not in glossary.
